title: The Tipsy Tile | Open Play Mahjong
seo_title: The Tipsy Tile Open Play Mahjong in Ozark, MO
description: The Tipsy Tile is an open play Mahjong gathering where you play at the table with fellow players and enjoy a drink; food and drinks are available for purchase. It is for experienced players who already know how to play, and admission is free, with reservations by calling (417) 882-0399. It takes place Wednesday, December 16, 2026, from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO.
